comment: M37: what the handles of the English text table hold, by range, so that a translator knows where a string belongs. Evidence: the M37 agent read the private catalog in handle order (SUPPORTED by content, not by observing each string on screen; 'display' says what is known about where it appears). Holds ids and labels only, never game text. A later rule overrides an earlier one. Voiced lines additionally carry their levels and speaker codes from the sound banks (VERIFIED from data), subtitles their movie (r3hd_loc.py). Categories: menu, system, tutorial, bonus_help, album, credits, dialogue, internal, legacy, placeholder.

categories.menu: menus, options, prompts and dialog boxes of the game's own interface
categories.system: platform messages (storage device, profiles, leaderboards, trial version)
categories.tutorial: hints and control instructions shown during play
categories.bonus_help: descriptions and controls of the bonus (arcade) games
categories.album: name / description pairs of characters and objects (the name line is centred with \jc)
categories.credits: staff credits: role headings and people's names
categories.dialogue: lines spoken or said by characters (voiced lines carry level and speaker code)
categories.subtitle: movie subtitle cues (VS.sub)
categories.internal: development labels and dummy strings; whether the game ever shows them is unknown
categories.legacy: messages of another platform (PlayStation 2 memory card); HYPOTHESIS: not shown on Xbox 360
categories.placeholder: button glyphs or icons only, no words
